name: Lithography & fab tools
thesis: Leading-edge wafer output depends on scarce lithography systems, deposition and etch tools, and metrology capacity. Tool assembly, installation and process qualification take longer than chip demand can change.
watch: Longer equipment delivery and installation queues, rising service utilization, and sustained orders for leading-edge fab equipment.
invalidate: Cancelled tool orders, shorter installation queues, and lower fab utilization despite installed capacity growth.

us_import_hs6.desc: Machines for manufacturing semiconductor devices or electronic integrated circuits; broad fab-equipment proxy.

name: Semiconductor materials
thesis: High-purity wafers, chemicals and contamination-control consumables must be qualified for each process. Expanding purification and crystal-growth capacity does not immediately create usable leading-edge supply.
watch: Longer qualified-wafer lead times, higher materials prices, and accelerating consumable revenue alongside wafer starts.
invalidate: Falling wafer utilization, excess inventories, and shorter qualification-adjusted material delivery times.

us_import_hs6.desc: Doped chemical elements and compounds for electronics, in discs or wafers; broader than silicon wafer demand.

name: Foundry logic
thesis: Logic chips require qualified process capacity with acceptable yield, and the newest nodes are concentrated in very few fabs. Buildings alone cannot remove shortages of trained operators, installed tools and working process recipes.
watch: Rising node-specific utilization, wafer pricing and capacity commitments, with sustained foundry revenue growth.
invalidate: Falling utilization and wafer prices, order deferrals, or new qualified capacity exceeding wafer demand.

name: Advanced packaging & HBM
thesis: AI accelerators need high-yield HBM stacks and advanced packages that connect memory to logic. TSV processing, bonding, interposers and package testing can constrain shipments even when logic wafers are available.
watch: Longer advanced-package reservations, rising HBM contract prices, and tighter bonding and package-test capacity.
invalidate: HBM inventories rise, packaging reservations are released, and yields or new qualified lines remove delivery queues.

basket.name: BE Semiconductor Industries
basket.role: Advanced die attach and hybrid bonding

kr_export_hs.desc: Electronic integrated circuits: memories; includes all memory types, not a separate HBM series.

name: Memory
thesis: DRAM and NAND supply depends on long fab cycles, process yields and allocation of wafer capacity to HBM. Storage drives and controller suppliers in this required basket are adjacent demand indicators rather than direct DRAM capacity.
watch: Rising DRAM and NAND contract prices, lower supplier inventories, and stronger Taiwan memory and controller revenue.
invalidate: Falling contract prices, rising inventory days, and wafer additions outpacing bit demand.

basket.name: Sandisk
basket.role: NAND flash and solid state storage

kr_export_hs.desc: Electronic integrated circuits: memories; DRAM, NAND and other IC memories combined.

name: Storage
thesis: Data-center storage requires qualified NAND controllers, enterprise SSDs and high-capacity hard drives. Drive yields, controller qualification and disk component capacity limit delivered exabytes.
watch: Rising enterprise SSD and nearline HDD prices, longer delivery times, and improving controller and module revenue.
invalidate: Enterprise drive inventories build, price premiums fall, and qualified capacity exceeds storage demand.

name: Substrates & PCB
thesis: Large accelerator packages and high-speed server boards need low-loss materials, fine traces and reliable multilayer fabrication. ABF substrate yields and high-layer-count PCB qualification restrict usable output.
watch: Longer ABF and high-layer-count board lead times, firmer pricing, and growing material and substrate revenue.
invalidate: Falling substrate utilization, easier laminate availability, and shorter board delivery times.

basket.name: TTM Technologies
basket.role: Advanced multilayer and high frequency PCBs

name: Photonics & optics
thesis: High-speed cluster links depend on qualified lasers, optical engines and precision optical assembly. Yield and packaging at higher transmission rates can restrict usable transceiver supply.
watch: Longer high-speed optical module lead times, rising laser orders, and broad-based Taiwan optical component revenue growth.
invalidate: Transceiver inventories rise, component delivery times shorten, and price erosion exceeds manufacturing cost reductions.

name: Networking & interconnect
thesis: AI clusters require switches, high-speed interface silicon and qualified systems to keep accelerators fed. Switch ASIC supply and system validation can cap the number of interconnected accelerators.
watch: Longer high-radix switch delivery times, rising switch orders and stronger networking ODM revenue.
invalidate: Switch inventories accumulate, lead times normalize, and port prices fall despite higher link speeds.

us_import_hs6.desc: Machines receiving, converting and transmitting or regenerating data, including switching and routing; includes non-data-center equipment.

name: Connectors & cables
thesis: Dense racks need reliable high-current connectors and high-speed copper cable assemblies. Precision contact manufacture, signal integrity and customer qualification limit substitution.
watch: Longer connector and cable assembly lead times, stronger orders and rising qualified supplier revenue.
invalidate: Second sources qualify, connector inventory builds, and assembly lead times and pricing decline.

basket.name: Amphenol
basket.role: High speed connectors and cable assemblies

basket.name: Aces Electronics
basket.role: High speed connectors and cable assemblies

us_import_hs6.desc: Electrical plugs and sockets for voltages not exceeding 1,000 V; broad connector proxy, not AI-specific.

name: AI servers
thesis: Accelerator servers need synchronized delivery of boards, power assemblies and thermal systems, followed by rack-level testing. Integration capacity and component shortages can delay shipments beyond accelerator availability.
watch: Growing server ODM revenue, longer rack acceptance queues, and orders rising faster than shipments.
invalidate: Rack delivery times shorten, cancelled orders increase, and finished-goods inventory rises.

name: Cooling & thermal
thesis: High-density racks require liquid cooling, cold plates and adequate heat rejection at the site. Qualified coolant distribution units, pumps and installation labor can limit powered rack deployment.
watch: Longer liquid-cooling equipment lead times, growing thermal supplier revenue, and cooling orders exceeding deliveries.
invalidate: Cooling equipment backlogs shrink, new vendors qualify, and site heat-rejection capacity catches up.

basket.name: Asia Vital Components
basket.role: Server thermal modules and liquid cooling

basket.name: Auras Technology
basket.role: Server thermal modules and liquid cooling

name: Power electronics
thesis: Accelerator racks need efficient AC-to-DC conversion and tightly regulated high-current power delivery. Qualified power semiconductors, magnetics and high-density power supplies limit rack power capacity.
watch: Longer high-density power supply lead times, stronger conversion module orders, and rising Taiwan power electronics revenue.
invalidate: Power module capacity expands, delivery times shorten, and qualified alternative designs reduce pricing pressure.

basket.name: Monolithic Power Systems
basket.role: High current point of load conversion

us_import_hs6.desc: Static converters, including power supplies and inverters; broad conversion proxy with substantial non-server demand.

name: Accelerators & custom silicon
thesis: Useful AI compute depends on accelerator designs that can be taped out, fabricated and packaged at acceptable yield. Scarce design teams, validated IP and access to leading-edge manufacturing limit deployable silicon.
watch: Longer custom ASIC project queues, rising design service revenue, and accelerator demand exceeding qualified production.
invalidate: Custom programs are delayed or cancelled, accelerator inventories rise, and qualified supply grows faster than demand.

name: AI cloud & neoclouds
thesis: Cloud GPU capacity is constrained by energized sites, accelerator deliveries and operating infrastructure. Contracted electrical capacity only becomes usable compute after construction, networking and commissioning.
watch: Longer waits for GPU clusters, firm rental rates, and contracted demand exceeding commissioned capacity; monitoring-only theme.
invalidate: GPU rental prices fall, utilization weakens, and newly energized capacity consistently exceeds customer commitments.

basket.name: Alphabet
basket.role: Google Cloud GPU and TPU infrastructure

basket.name: IREN
basket.role: Power sites and GPU cloud operator

name: Rare earths & magnets
thesis: High-performance motors and compact actuators require rare-earth magnet materials that pass demanding purity and performance tests. Separation, metal refining and qualified magnet production are concentrated and slow to expand.
watch: Longer NdFeB delivery times, higher separated oxide and magnet prices, and tighter export availability alongside end-market orders.
invalidate: New separation and qualified magnet capacity ramps, delivery restrictions ease, and inventories rebuild across the chain.

basket.name: MP Materials
basket.role: Rare earth mining and magnet production

basket.name: Ningbo Yunsheng
basket.role: High performance rare earth permanent magnets

us_import_hs6.desc: Permanent magnets of metal; includes rare-earth and other metal magnets, so not a pure rare-earth series.

name: Gas turbines & generation equipment
thesis: New gas-fired capacity needs turbine manufacturing slots, high-temperature components and commissioning crews. Forgings, castings and hot-section parts cannot be replaced quickly when order books fill.
watch: Longer turbine reservation queues, larger equipment backlogs, rising service demand and firm contract pricing.
invalidate: Turbine slot availability improves, component bottlenecks clear, and orders or project starts slow.

basket.name: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries
basket.role: Large gas turbines and power systems

basket.name: Rolls-Royce Holdings
basket.role: Gas generator sets and backup power

us_import_hs6.desc: Gas turbines other than turbojets or turbopropellers, of power exceeding 5,000 kW; stationary generation equipment proxy.

name: Transformers
thesis: Grid connections require transformers sized and tested for the specific voltage and load. Electrical steel, windings, skilled assembly and high-voltage testing capacity constrain deliveries.
watch: Longer transformer delivery quotes, growing order backlogs and Taiwan electrical-equipment revenue, with import values checked against prices.
invalidate: Delivery quotes shorten, factory and test capacity expands, and backlog conversion exceeds new orders.

basket.name: Vertiv Holdings
basket.role: Transformer adjacent data center power systems

us_import_hs6.desc: Liquid dielectric transformers, power handling capacity not exceeding 650 kVA.
Liquid dielectric transformers, power handling capacity exceeding 650 kVA but not exceeding 10,000 kVA.
Liquid dielectric transformers, power handling capacity exceeding 10,000 kVA.

kr_export_hs.desc: Liquid dielectric transformers, power handling capacity exceeding 10,000 kVA.

name: Switchgear & grid equipment
thesis: Energizing new load requires switchgear, protection and substation equipment certified for the local grid. Breaker components, assembly capacity and testing queues limit complete switchboard deliveries.
watch: Longer switchgear lead times, growing electrical backlogs, and stronger Taiwan substation-equipment revenue.
invalidate: Switchgear queues shorten, qualified breaker supply expands, and electrical-equipment inventories build.

basket.name: Hubbell
basket.role: Utility protection and grid connection equipment

us_import_hs6.desc: Boards, panels and other bases for electrical control or distribution, for voltage exceeding 1,000 V.

name: Transmission cables
thesis: High-voltage transmission projects need long qualified cable runs, accessories and specialized installation. Extrusion lines, testing facilities and cable-laying capacity are difficult to expand quickly.
watch: High-voltage cable order books lengthen, installation slots tighten, and cable prices rise beyond metal-cost pass-through.
invalidate: New qualified lines and vessels enter service, backlog delivery accelerates, and project cancellations release slots.

basket.name: Prysmian
basket.role: High voltage land and submarine cables

basket.name: Taihan Cable & Solution
basket.role: Extra high voltage transmission cable systems

us_import_hs6.desc: Other electric conductors, for a voltage exceeding 1,000 V; includes medium-voltage as well as transmission cables.

name: Nuclear & SMR
thesis: Nuclear deployment needs qualified fuel, nuclear-grade components and licensed designs before construction can become operating capacity. Enrichment and large-component qualification take years, while SMR designs also face first-unit execution constraints.
watch: Fuel conversion or enrichment contracts tighten, component backlogs grow, and funded projects pass licensing milestones; monitoring-only theme.
invalidate: Fuel and component capacity expands, delivery queues shorten, or project cancellations reduce committed demand.

basket.name: BWX Technologies
basket.role: Nuclear reactor components and fuel services

name: Batteries & storage
thesis: Grid storage requires safe battery cells, qualified conversion systems and integrated enclosures. Fire testing, manufacturing yields and interconnection work constrain commissioned storage more than announced cell capacity.
watch: Longer grid-storage delivery and commissioning queues, stronger contracted backlog, and firm system prices despite cell price changes.
invalidate: Qualified system output rises, commissioned projects catch up with orders, and excess cell or inverter inventory accumulates.

basket.name: Contemporary Amperex Technology
basket.role: Lithium ion cells and storage systems

basket.name: Samsung SDI
basket.role: Lithium ion cells for stationary storage

us_import_hs6.desc: Lithium-ion accumulators; includes vehicle and consumer batteries, not just stationary storage.

kr_export_hs.desc: Lithium-ion accumulators; broad battery exports including EV cells and packs.

name: Power producers
thesis: Data centers need firm electricity at the right location and hour, not merely annual energy output. Transmission congestion, interconnection queues and plant availability restrict deliverable megawatts.
watch: Rising firm-power contract premiums, longer interconnection waits, and tightening local reserve margins; monitoring-only theme.
invalidate: New generation and grid capacity enter service, local reserve margins recover, and firm-power contract premiums fall.

basket.name: NextEra Energy
basket.role: Utility generation and renewable power development

name: Construction & MEP
thesis: Data centers and grid projects need skilled electricians, mechanical installation and coordinated commissioning. Labor availability and project sequencing can prevent completed equipment from becoming energized capacity.
watch: Electrical and mechanical contractor backlogs rise, labor costs increase, and completion dates extend despite equipment deliveries; Taiwan signals primarily reflect fab-facility work.
invalidate: Labor availability improves, construction schedules shorten, and backlog burn exceeds new awards.

basket.name: Marketech International
basket.role: Fab facility and utility systems integration

name: Precision motion & actuators
thesis: Robots need repeatable motion from low-backlash reducers, precision bearings, ball screws and servo drives. Machining tolerances, heat treatment and lifetime qualification limit reliable actuator output.
watch: Longer reducer and linear-motion lead times, higher utilization, and sustained precision-motion supplier revenue growth.
invalidate: New qualified capacity reduces delivery times, component inventories rise, and precision-motion prices weaken.

basket.name: THK
basket.role: Linear motion guides and ball screws

basket.name: Yaskawa Electric
basket.role: Precision servo motors and motion drives

basket.name: HIWIN Technologies
basket.role: Linear guides ball screws and actuators

basket.name: HIWIN Mikrosystem
basket.role: Linear motors and motion control systems

name: Sensing & vision
thesis: Robot perception requires industrial cameras, precise sensors and reliable real-time inspection. Optical alignment, specialized image sensors and application qualification restrict deployable sensing systems.
watch: Longer industrial sensor and camera lead times, rising vision-system orders, and stronger machine-vision computing revenue; Advantech revenue is a diversified industrial-computing proxy.
invalidate: Camera and sensor lead times shorten, qualified alternatives proliferate, and customer inventories rise.

name: Industrial robots & automation
thesis: Factory automation requires robots, controllers and safety systems integrated into a working production cell. Application engineering, commissioning and reliable component supply constrain installed throughput.
watch: Robot and factory-control orders exceed shipments, integrator backlogs grow, and industrial computing revenue strengthens.
invalidate: Automation order books shrink, commissioning labor becomes available, and controller inventories normalize.

us_import_hs6.desc: Industrial robots, not elsewhere specified or included; excludes many service robots and complete specialized machines.

name: Robot platforms
thesis: Commercial robot platforms need integrated motion, perception and safety that survive real operating environments. Reliability testing and repeatable assembly constrain the transition from demonstrations to deployed fleets.
watch: Paid deployments and repeat orders grow faster than qualified assembly and service capacity; industrial-robot imports cover only the industrial subset.
invalidate: Field reliability improves and production outpaces orders, or pilot cancellations reveal insufficient demand for scaled deployment.

basket.role: Collaborative and autonomous mobile robot platforms

basket.role: Collaborative and mobile humanoid robot platforms

basket.role: Collaborative robot arms and application platforms

basket.role: Industrial robot hardware and control platforms
